title: Root Fang

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Root Fang is the upgraded form of Ash Fang using Jade. Like all upgraded-weapons that use Jade, they gain 10 poison damage and their hit effect has a 20% chance to apply Immobilized.
An upgraded Ash Fang will NOT keep its upgrade level when it is modified using gemstones.

Introduction. Root Fang is the upgraded form of Ash Fang using Jade. Like all upgraded-weapons that use Jade, they gain 10 poison damage and their hit effect has a 20% chance to apply Immobilized.
